issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Lecture.addGuestStudents: the problem statement (task description and UML) specifies a single-parameter method addGuestStudents(int), and the solution implementation defines public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). However, the template stub declares public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) (an extra boolean parameter). This discrepancy will confuse students and cause signature mismatches with the tests or the expected implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem statement and solution by changing the template stub signature to the single-parameter form: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { /* ... */ }. If input validation is desired, implement it inside that method body or provide an additional private helper or an overloaded method (but keep the public API matching the specification). Update the TODO comment to reflect the single-parameter signature so students implement the expected method.
